critique: The note proves the optimizer-wide rectangle normal form, the complete boundary-safe L=3 classification, and matching constructions for both branches of the sharp general-L interval-price bound, so its main identification and sharpness claims are delivered rather than deferred. The selector theorem is narrower than the TL;DR phrase “away from explicit tie surfaces” suggests: uniform recovery is proved only on a fixed-eta class that removes positive-width neighborhoods around feasibility boundaries, not uniformly over all laws outside the tie surfaces. The advertised remdesivir relevance is not demonstrated with trial marginals, a computed selected set, or a sensitivity analysis, leaving the practical significance supported only by the seven-category complexity count and worst-case oracle constants. This absence of an executed application, together with the specialized finite-support target, constrains the leading-journal score despite the field-level theoretical contribution.
